label: Sticker Headline
description: The brand hero line: a large light editorial serif with STICKERS SET BETWEEN THE WORDS, like a printed headline with die-cut illustrations dropped into it ("All [sticker-notebook] that's left\nis the [sticker-checklist] marketing. [sticker-pie-chart]"). Words land in reading order; each sticker pops in right after the word before it and settles at a small tilt; [>name] flies in from the left (a paper plane). A sticker name is the brand kit's sticker asset by name first, then the house sticker library. One per scene, the scene's subject: the hook, a promise, the close. 1-3 lines, 2-4 stickers.

text.label: The headline. \n breaks lines (each line stays on one line, the type sizes to fit the box). [name] sets a sticker between words, [>name] flies it in from the left. Use the brand kit's sticker names (sticker-flows, sticker-checklist ...) or house library names.

font.label: Font-family override (default the brand's headline serif stand-in, 'Newsreader')

color.label: Type colour (default the brand text colour)

size.label: Fixed type size (CSS); default fits the widest line to the box

at.label: When the first word lands (default the component's entrance, else 0.3)
